About me

Manufacturing expertise, translated into business value.

I am an SAP Functional Consultant with experience across SAP PP, QM, MM and PLM, supporting manufacturing organizations through rollouts, go-lives, enhancements and post-go-live stabilization.

My work spans requirements, configuration, master data, custom reports, testing, data migration and user enablement. I enjoy working at the intersection of shop-floor realities, process discipline and technology.
